title: Coordinate a tax audit or examination
summary: When a tax authority opens a formal examination or requests records beyond routine filing clarification. A controlled response record with adviser-reviewed submissions, tracked findings and authorized resolution.
outcomes: A controlled response record with adviser-reviewed submissions, tracked findings and authorized resolution.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a tax authority opens a formal examination or requests records beyond routine filing clarification.

parts.title: Preserve the notice and relevant records
parts.guidance: Record the authority, taxpayer, period, scope, response channel and dates stated in the notice. Preserve existing evidence and pause routine disposal for the affected records without changing historical documents.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Appoint the adviser and agree the response strategy
parts.guidance: Verify the authority contact and have qualified tax counsel or the accountant assess representation, response dates and the scope of information requested. Assign one response owner and resolve privilege or confidentiality questions before disclosure.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Appoint the adviser and agree the response strategy

parts.title: Build a reconciled evidence and request register
parts.guidance: Map requests to returns, ledgers, invoices and supporting workpapers. Identify omissions and discrepancies openly, maintaining source versions and an index of what has been reviewed and supplied.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve responses and manage authority discussions
parts.guidance: The authorized representative reviews factual explanations and documents before submission. Track follow-up questions and meeting records without admitting disputed conclusions or agreeing adjustments outside approved authority.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve responses and manage authority discussions

parts.title: Review findings and close or contest the examination
parts.guidance: Have advisers assess proposed changes, response rights and relevant dates for the specific jurisdiction. Obtain authority for a settlement, challenge or amended return and retain the final decision, payments and continuing obligations.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review findings and close or contest the examination

verify.how: A controlled response record with adviser-reviewed submissions, tracked findings and authorized resolution.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
